desc: 软管洁面乳绵密泡沫、温和清洁、洗后舒适不紧绷
name: 雾蓝绵密泡沫温和洁面乳款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的主图
一秒传达温和清洁核心利益，主图一秒法则
放大洗后紧绷干涩的日常痛点，引出温和清洁
代入清晨洗漱场景，营造清爽舒适的使用感
用细腻均匀的气泡质感证明温和亲肤的清洁体验
用结构化图解讲清洁步骤，消除怎么用好不好用的疑虑
同机位对比两种泡沫质感，证明绵密稳定的使用差异
并列展示可选规格，让买家按需选择
用包装与留白背书位降风险，资质留待后期合成
深色收口聚焦产品，明确行动号召促单

style.backgroundSystem: clean pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and trust, foam-mist white #F3F7FA for info and scene, cool grey marble #ECEDEE and #EAECEE stone for lifestyle, deep steel teal #3F6E99 only for the closing shot
style.iconSystem: minimal thin-line icons in one accent color only
style.lightingSystem: bright soft cool studio lighting, front-left key with gentle bounce fill, soft contact shadows, one skimming side light reserved for macro texture, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh foaming cleanser visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of foam-mist white #F3F7FA, tube mist blue #A8C8E0, steel teal accent #3F6E99 and ink teal text #2F3E4D; bright soft cool studio lighting with a front-left key, gentle bounce fill and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; minimal thin-line icon style; clean high-key skincare photography over airy foam textures and cool marble surfaces; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no invented certifications or efficacy numbers
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the tube across the set; foam always rendered as dense fine bubbles
style.surfaceSystem: cool grey marble #ECEDEE and pale stone vanity #EAECEE tabletops with airy foam textures
